answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 24299 Country: India Title: Please tell me whether we can cut our beard when it is grown more than one fist or not? Question: asalamalaikum please tell me whether we can cut our beard when it is grown more than one fist or not jazakallah Answer ID: 24299 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1265/943/L=1431) Yes, you can cut [the extra length after one fist]. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
